assets.name: prambanan-dawn
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset for Pramaya interactive watercolor wedding invitation, Mental Canvas 2. A poetic view of the recognizable Prambanan Hindu temple compound in Java, slender tall central Shiva temple with tiered pointed ratna pinnacle and smaller temples, viewed along warm pale sandstone garden path, jasmine and frangipani framing sides. Calm open central space, distant hazy Merapi silhouette. Hand painted traditional delicate watercolor on cotton canvas, visible fine pigment granulation and loose brushwork. Palette muted warm stone taupe, dusty terracotta, soft sage accents, antique gold, warm ivory, dusty mauve; moderately desaturated but alive, neither vivid nor washed out. Deep foreground midground distant atmosphere. Portrait 2:3 composition fills canvas. No text, logos, border, photorealism, glossy rendering or 3D.
